name: agenttrail-local
description: MCP bridge contract for AgentTrail local tools. Run `npm run mcp`; medium/high-risk tools require explicit approval before execution.

approvals.scope: read workspace file names and content snippets
produce a diff for one workspace-relative file
write one workspace-relative file after explicit approval

hardRules: No network tools without separate approval
No write_file when preview mode is enabled
Every action emits an Agent Trail receipt
